def snap(fr):
    s={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b);c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        s.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((n['pixels'],r0,c0))
    return s
def diff(a,b):
    d={}
    for c in set(a)|set(b):
        if a.get(c)!=b.get(c): d[c]=(a.get(c),b.get(c))
    return d
